generated_by: Manual extraction from the BLS Schedule of Selected Releases annual pages via text fetch (browser.open), 2026-11-18. BLS returns HTTP 403 to direct programmatic requests (curl), so the calendar was read from the rendered schedule pages and transcribed here; it is not BLS API output. The extraction is validated by research/macro-windows-006/fetch_data.py (counts, known dates, reference-month continuity) and by tests/test_studies_macro.py.

not_published.reason: 2025 lapse in federal government appropriations (Oct 1 - Nov 12, 2025): BLS could not collect October 2025 reference-period survey data and did not issue an October 2025 CPI news release. The archived releases page lists it as 'Not published because of 2025 lapse in federal government appropriations'. No event exists for this reference month, so no window bar is created.

out_of_scope.note: The December 2026 CPI releases 2027-01-13 (per the BLS current schedule page), after the study sample ends; it is not in the releases list.

release_time_note: Every CPI release is 08:30 Eastern Time, per the BLS schedule pages ('NOTE: All times on calendar are Eastern Time'). 08:30 ET is 12:30 UTC in daylight saving time and 13:30 UTC in standard time, always before the 16:00 UTC OKX daily bar open.

shutdown_notes.note: Originally scheduled 2025-10-15; delayed by the shutdown. BLS recalled staff Oct 9-24, 2025 to produce it (needed for the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment) and released it on Friday, 2025-10-24, during the lapse. Confirmed by the BLS shutdown FAQ and contemporaneous news coverage. The release date in this file is the actual release date, not the original schedule date.
Released 2025-12-18, later than the usual mid-month slot, on the revised post-shutdown schedule.
